purpose: Verify end-to-end workflow path from complaint submission through handler assignment/progress to Resolved state.
preconditions: Complainant and active Complaint Handler accounts exist.
action_or_input: Submit complaint -> assign handler/category/priority -> post progress update -> resolve with resolution details.
expected_result: Complaint transitions cleanly to Resolved with full status and progress audit history.

purpose: Verify complete workflow path from intake to Closed via User / Complainant closure verification.
preconditions: Closure verifier configured as complainant; Complainant and Handler exist.
action_or_input: Submit complaint -> handle and resolve -> Complainant verifies closure.
expected_result: Complaint reaches Closed state with recorded complainant verification and notification triggers.

purpose: Verify complete workflow path from intake to Closed via Complaint Supervisor closure verification.
preconditions: Closure verifier configured as supervisor; Complainant, Handler, and Supervisor exist.
action_or_input: Submit complaint -> handle and resolve -> Supervisor verifies closure.
expected_result: Complaint reaches Closed state with recorded supervisor verification and notification triggers.

purpose: Verify workflow path from complaint submission to Rejected outcome with required rejection reason.
preconditions: Complainant and active Complaint Handler exist.
action_or_input: Submit complaint -> assign handler -> reject complaint with rejection reason.
expected_result: Complaint transitions to Rejected, rejection reason is stored, and rejection notification is triggered.

purpose: Verify reopening decision workflow when Supervisor denies a Complainant's reopening request.
preconditions: Closed complaint exists; Complainant and active Complaint Supervisor exist.
action_or_input: Complainant requests reopening -> Supervisor denies reopening request.
expected_result: Denial decision is recorded and complaint remains in Closed state.

purpose: Verify reopening decision workflow when Supervisor approves a Complainant's reopening request.
preconditions: Closed complaint exists; Complainant and active Complaint Supervisor exist.
action_or_input: Complainant requests reopening -> Supervisor approves reopening request.
expected_result: Approval decision is recorded, complaint reopens to configured active state, and notification is triggered.

purpose: Verify manual escalation workflow path for an unresolved complaint.
preconditions: Unresolved complaint and active Complaint Supervisor exist.
action_or_input: Manually escalate unresolved complaint -> Supervisor inspects escalated complaints list.
expected_result: Complaint is marked manually escalated, appears in Supervisor oversight list, and triggers escalation notification.

purpose: Verify automatic SLA escalation workflow path when an unresolved complaint breaches its priority SLA timeline.
preconditions: Unresolved complaint with priority and configured SLA hours has breached its deadline.
expected_result: Complaint is automatically escalated, escalation status is recorded, and escalation notification is triggered.
